reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the limitation of soft ferromagnetism in prior FeCoNiPd/Pt alloys by proposing Mn substitution to introduce antiferromagnetic coupling and lattice strain for domain wall pinning, which is physically sound for this material system. It is specific, testable, and grounded in known magnetic behavior of Mn, whereas Hypothesis B relies on an unsubstantiated FCC-to-BCC transformation via Sn addition, which lacks clear precedent in FeCoNi-based high-entropy alloys and may violate the single-phase constraint implied by the question.
